chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Khālid narrated from ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā, from Samāʿah ibn Mihrān, who said:
I asked him about a man who fabricates a false accusation: how should the Imam strike him? He said: “A flogging between the two floggings.”

key_terms.بَيْنَ الْجَلْدَيْنِ: between the two floggings, meaning an intermediate number of lashes
key_terms.جَلْدٌ: flogging or lashing as a legal punishment
key_terms.لِلْإِمَامِ: for the Imam, meaning the legitimate authority implementing the ruling
key_terms.يَضْرِبَهُ: to strike him, referring here to corporal punishment
key_terms.يَفْتَرِي: to fabricate or forge a false accusation

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a person who makes a false accusation according to this hadith from Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the punishment for one who commits false accusation or slander. The Imam عليه السلام states that the punishment is a flogging set at an intermediate level between two known corporal punishments.
